_comment: Sovereign-mesh node/capability registry. DECLARATIVE source of truth for capability-routed federation (research-review docs/99-session-notes/2026-06-29-research-review-sovereign-mesh-two-nas-replication-federation.md). The job router selects the node whose declared `caps` is a superset of a job's `requires`, health-green, cheapest/closest first. DECLARED, NOT GUESSED (DR-0061 reality-trace) and DETERMINISTIC (no LLM in the dispatch decision; the LLM is only the worker on the chosen node). Generalizes the vendor-axis picker in scripts/wake-router.mjs + DR-0073 to a node axis. The two church CUDA towers are NETWORKED LOCAL-CODER WORKERS (Aider + Ollama + qwen2.5-coder:14b), not just inference endpoints: tiered dispatch sends heavy/novel reasoning to vendor Claude and routine/bounded build + transcription + voice to the local towers IN PARALLEL (two towers + home NAS). Honest limit (DR-0076): local coders are weaker on hard reasoning -> well-scoped tasks only; vendor reserved for the hard problems. SHIPS INERT: editing this file does not arm anything; routing still passes through the per-node Cage brakes (infra/ai-orchestrator/portable/orchestrator/lib/brakes.sh) and the mesh kill-switch. Values marked SME-CONFIRM are flagged for Darrell/BG (church hardware, GPU-endpoint IP, church NAS access) per the research-review section 6 — DO NOT fabricate; an SME-CONFIRM cap is treated as OFFLINE by the router until a real value lands. DB LAYER (see db_topology below): DR-0080 — Supabase cloud is the PUBLIC edge/shield; the home NAS is the PRIVATE sovereign canonical (subscriber that dials out, never a public port); one-way sync per tier (single-writer per datum); church NAS = encrypted sealed-blob backup. The always-on build driver (scripts/orchestrator-v0/v05.mjs) is resident on home-ds1621xs and dispatches build lanes through this registry (2026-07-01-sovereign-mesh-both-sites-go-turnkey.md).

mesh_kill_switch.note: registry-side mesh-wide kill-switch; UNREACHABLE = treated as ENGAGED (fail closed)

db_topology._ref: DR-0080 (hybrid Supabase edge-shield + NAS sovereign canonical) — the DB instantiation of this mesh's single-writer-per-datum invariant. One-way sync per tier; no datum has two writers; dependency-gated on Darrell's per-phase go, nothing arms unattended.

public_edge.role: PUBLIC edge/shield: all internet exposure + auth (GoTrue); Tier-P write-primary. NOT a mesh node — the buffer in front of the mesh. A home outage never takes down poetech.us.

canonical.role: PRIVATE sovereign canonical: Tier-P read-only mirror (subscriber that DIALS OUT to Supabase — zero inbound; DB port 127.0.0.1-bound) + Tier-S write-primary. Tailnet/LAN only, never a public port.

backup_replica.role: encrypted SEALED-BLOB offsite backup — stores, never reads (DR-0003).

tiers.P: public/operational tables -> Supabase writes; replicate downstream cloud->NAS via Postgres logical replication (Supabase PUBLISHES, NAS SUBSCRIBES).
tiers.S: sovereign-sensitive (family financial/legal, TLC/PHI, DR-0003) -> NAS writes; stays on the NAS; served over tailnet; NEVER pushed to cloud.

nodes.role: serve + storage + cpu + registry + db-canonical + build-driver host

endpoints.db_canonical: 127.0.0.1:5432 (tailnet/LAN admin only — never a public port; DR-0080)

nodes.notes: Verified: Xeon D-1527 4c/8t CPU-only, 32 GB ECC, dual 10 GbE. Runs Caddy poetech-web, n8n, self-hosted Supabase compose (infra/supabase/). DB canonical per DR-0080: Tier-P read-only mirror (subscriber that DIALS OUT to Supabase, zero inbound) + Tier-S write-primary; served over tailnet only. Hosts the always-on build driver (scripts/orchestrator-v0/v05.mjs — ships INERT, human-triggered; scheduler=v1 not built) and the single authoritative registry/ledger. DB Phase-0 (DR-0080): relocate Ollama to the church towers to free NAS headroom -> then this box's ollama-cpu cap goes offline by design.

nodes.role: sovereign coder worker + gpu (Aider + Ollama coder / voice clone / whisper / local 14B LLM)
nodes.notes: Tower 1 of 2 (an OBS/ProPresenter box on the church LAN — NOT the Synology NAS; assign the AI-WORKER role, kept off the live-media tower). Exact GPU/VRAM per on-site inventory (runbook 2026-06-29-church-compute-towers-setup-runbook.md section 2, [NEEDS SPEC]); Darrell states RTX 4070-class. Networked LOCAL-CODER WORKER: Aider + Ollama + qwen2.5-coder:14b (the Cage OLLAMA_CODER_MODEL) sized to the tower's real VRAM (~12 GB -> 14B Q5). Also serves the inference endpoints (real ports per PR #405 / [[project_church_gpu_node]]). SME-CONFIRM the IP only. One large model resident at a time (OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1) -> coder and whisper/voice CONTEND; schedule, do not co-pin. Passive/allowlisted; brakes live on the caller. DR-0012 service-time preemption during Sunday/Wednesday live.

nodes.role: sovereign coder worker + gpu (parallel second tower)
nodes.notes: Tower 2 of 2 — the parallel second local-coder worker (same stack as tower 1). Two towers = two routine build/transcription/voice jobs in parallel + the home NAS. SME-CONFIRM the IP only.

nodes.role: serve + storage (media corpus) + encrypted sealed-blob DB backup replica
nodes.notes: SME-CONFIRM: tlcrackstation (Synology RackStation). On the tailnet but fully firewalled (22/5000/5001/5678/11434/443 filtered, 2026-06-10). Holds the ~100 TB recording corpus (node-local, referenced by ID). Per DR-0080/DR-0003: the encrypted SEALED-BLOB offsite DB backup replica — STORES, NEVER READS (not a live replica, not a second writer). Access = a credential/his-hand step (Darrell/BG).

job_classes.note: well-scoped/bounded build tasks -> least-loaded healthy church tower, two towers in parallel; HARD/NOVEL reasoning is NOT this class -> see code-reasoning-hard. Local coders are weaker on hard reasoning: well-scoped only; on a task that proves hard, ESCALATE to vendor, never ship a confident-wrong diff. Same gates (tests/build/guards) apply before trust.
heavy/novel/ambiguous reasoning + cross-cutting design -> vendor Claude (ORCH_MODE vendor-first). Reserved for the hard problems the 14B local coder should not attempt.
private family voice -> church GPU only; if offline, WAITS (never a cloud vendor)
church recordings -> church GPU; private; brakes on the caller queue
non-private heavy gen -> church GPU; vendor fallback only when armed+budgeted+GPU-offline
reconciliation / CPU jobs / deploy-sync -> home DS1621xs
audit ledger / pgvector -> home NAS single instance (no split-brain)
